subject: general
question: In a circular path of 600 m, Pankaj and Rohit start walking in opposite directions from the same point at the speeds of 2.85 m/s and 5.4 km/h, respectively. After how many minutes will they meet for the first time? (Rounded off to one decimal point)
solution:
**Given:**

The circular path is = 600 m

The speed of the Pankanj = 2.85 m/s

The speed of the Rohit = 5.4 km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed={Distanceover Time}

**Calculation:**

Let they will meet first time be T

The speed of Rohit = 5.4 × {5over18} = 0.3 × 5 = 1.5 m/s

The relative speed of Pankaj and Rohit = 1.5 + 2.85 = 4.35 m/s

The time when they will first time = {600over 4.35}= 137.93 seconds={137.93over60}={2.3 min}

**∴ The required result will be 2.3 min.**
